overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《利用机器学习加速从分子动力学计算晶体结构中的扩散系数》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
full_list.title_zh: MindTopo：基础模型能够在拓扑空间中进行推理吗？
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo contains 11,030 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types with controllable difficulty. We benchmark 14 MLLMs and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, including 3 video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning, and the best-performing model remains far below observed human performance. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach plausible endpoints, but audited rollouts do not reliably follow environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions. Our website is at https://mind-topo.github.io/
full_list.abstract_zh: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度和形状等度量性质，也依赖在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。本文提出MindTopo基准，基于认知科学和形式拓扑学，从连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结五种性质评估基础模型的拓扑直觉，并分别考察推理和规划两个认知层次。实验包含11030个实例和13类可控制难度的程序生成任务，结果显示所有多模态大语言模型的推理表现均优于规划表现，最佳模型仍远低于人类水平；图像和视频生成增强的智能体也无法可靠地遵循环境动力学或在状态转换中保持拓扑结构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 空间推理不仅取决于距离、角度和形状等度量性质，还取决于在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。认知科学将这些关系视为空间理解的基础，但对基础模型的评估主要集中于度量关系或依赖观察视角的关系。我们提出MindTopo，这是一个评估拓扑直觉的基准，涵盖五种基于认知科学和形式拓扑学的性质：连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结。MindTopo在两个认知层次上评估每种性质。推理任务要求模型识别拓扑关系，或推断这些关系如何变化。规划任务则将基础模型实例化为闭环智能体，由其策略选择环境动作。MindTopo包含11030个实例，覆盖13类可程序生成且难度可控的任务。我们对14个多模态大语言模型进行基准测试，并研究了加入图像和视频生成能力的智能体配置，其中包括在规划设置中使用的3个视频生成模型。所有多模态大语言模型在推理任务上的表现都优于规划任务，表现最好的模型仍远低于观察到的人类表现。在Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct上，监督微调和强化学习对推理能力的提升大于对规划能力的提升。生成的观测结果保留了局部线索并到达看似合理的终点，但经过审计的运行轨迹无法可靠地遵循环境动力学，也无法在状态转换过程中保持拓扑结构。

full_list.title_en: Physics-guided explainable machine learning and uncertainty quantification for predicting unconfined compressive strength of nano shale–quicklime stabilized kaolin clay
full_list.title_zh: 用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土无侧限抗压强度的物理引导可解释机器学习与不确定性量化
full_list.abstract: Data-driven prediction of stabilized-soil strength is often constrained by small experimental datasets, leakage between related specimens, and limited physical interpretability. This study develops an explainable, uncertainty-aware framework to predict the unconfined compressive strength (UCS) of nano shale–quicklime stabilized kaolin. A specimen-level database of 180 measurements from 36 mixture–curing conditions was analyzed using multiple linear regression (MLR), support vector regression (SVR), random forest (RF), XGBoost, CatBoost, and backpropagation artificial neural network (BP-ANN), with nonlinear models optimized by particle swarm optimization and evaluated through nested GroupKFold cross-validation. Mechanism-inspired features represented binder dosage, binder–curing interactions, nonlinear curing behavior, relative plasticity, and compaction state. Sequential feature ablation identified a compact CatBoost model with six physics-guided descriptors, achieving R2 = 0.841 ± 0.123 and RMSE = 151.11 ± 34.94 kPa. SHAP analysis, sensitivity assessment, and two-dimensional partial dependence mapping identified plasticity, curing duration, and binder–curing interactions as dominant controls and revealed nonlinear stabilizer effects and favorable binder combinations. Monte Carlo input perturbation and group-bootstrap resampling quantified input-driven and model-related uncertainty, with the highest 95% prediction-interval coverage reaching 0.894. The framework provides a physically interpretable, reliability-aware approach for preliminary stabilized-soil screening while retaining confirmatory laboratory testing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度，并比较了多种回归与机器学习模型。研究通过物理机制启发的特征、嵌套分组交叉验证、SHAP分析及不确定性量化，确定塑性、养护龄期和胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素；最终得到的紧凑型CatBoost模型在可靠性意识下为稳定土初步筛选提供了具有物理解释的工具，但仍需实验室试验进行确认。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度（UCS）。研究分析了一个试样层面的数据库，其中包含来自36种混合物-养护条件的180次测量，并采用多元线性回归（MLR）、支持向量回归（SVR）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost、CatBoost和反向传播人工神经网络（BP-ANN）进行建模；其中，非线性模型通过粒子群优化进行优化，并通过嵌套式GroupKFold交叉验证进行评估。受机理启发构建的特征表示了胶结料掺量、胶结料-养护相互作用、非线性养护行为、相对塑性和压实状态。顺序特征消融识别出一个包含六个物理引导描述符的紧凑型CatBoost模型，其表现达到R2 = 0.841 ± 0.123，RMSE = 151.11 ± 34.94 kPa。SHAP分析、敏感性评估和二维部分依赖关系映射表明，塑性、养护时间以及胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素，并揭示了非线性稳定剂效应和有利的胶结料组合。研究通过蒙特卡罗输入扰动和分组自助法重采样，分别量化了由输入引起的不确定性和与模型相关的不确定性；其中，最高的95%预测区间覆盖率达到0.894。该框架在保留实验室确认试验必要性的同时，为稳定土初步筛选提供了一种具有物理可解释性并关注可靠性的途径。
full_list.summary: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度，并比较了多种回归与机器学习模型。研究通过物理机制启发的特征、嵌套分组交叉验证、SHAP分析及不确定性量化，确定塑性、养护龄期和胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素；最终得到的紧凑型CatBoost模型在可靠性意识下为稳定土初步筛选提供了具有物理解释的工具，但仍需实验室试验进行确认。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土无侧限抗压强度的物理引导可解释机器学习与不确定性量化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Electrolytes for Lithium Batteries
full_list.title_zh: 用于锂电池电解质电子结构分析的密度矩阵框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.25597v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electrolyte reactivity in lithium batteries is shaped by molecular functional groups, Li⁺ solvation and salt-anion participation. Conventional quantum chemistry is too computationally expensive for systematic analysis of diverse electrolyte molecules and their local solvation environments. Here we present EMolStudio, a density-matrix-centered AI platform for electronic-structure prediction and analysis. Its workflow integrates molecular functionalization, explicit Li⁺ first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction, and electronic-structure parsing. Applied to 163,655 functionalized molecules and 22,500 first-shell clusters across four lithium salts, we find that 1) functionalization separates CO₂Me, CN, F/CF₃, and sulfonyl groups by distinct shifts in frontier levels, electrostatic potential, and Li⁺-donor contact; 2) anion identity reshapes frontier-orbital localization, with LiTDI anchoring the highest occupied orbital on the anion across the library. By carrying a unified density-matrix representation from molecular functionalization to salt-resolved solvation shells, EMolStudio provides a general platform for understanding and designing battery electrolytes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 锂电池中电解质的反应性受到分子官能团、Li⁺溶剂化以及盐阴离子参与的共同影响，而传统量子化学方法难以系统分析多样化电解质分子及其局部溶剂化环境。本文提出以密度矩阵为核心的人工智能平台EMolStudio，整合分子官能化、显式Li⁺第一溶剂化层组装、密度矩阵预测和电子结构解析。对163655个官能化分子和22500个第一溶剂化层团簇的研究显示，不同官能团会引起前线能级、静电势和Li⁺-供体接触的特征性变化，阴离子种类则会重塑前线轨道局域化。该平台通过统一的密度矩阵表示连接分子官能化与盐分辨溶剂化壳层，为理解和设计电池电解质提供了通用工具。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Federated Digital Twin Framework with Explainable Multi-Agent Intelligence for Autonomous Engineering Management
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Federated Digital Twin Framework with Explainable Multi-Agent Intelligence for Autonomous Engineering Management
full_list.abstract: Autonomous engineering management increasingly depends on distributed digital twins that must learn, coordinate, and justify decisions across geographically separated industrial sites without exposing proprietary operating data. Existing solutions address these needs only in isolation: federated learning preserves data locality but offers no formal guarantee against gradient-based information leakage; multi-agent reinforcement learning coordinates distributed controllers but rarely explains its own decisions; and digital twins provide high-fidelity virtual representations but are seldom coupled to a decision layer that can act autonomously while remaining auditable by human engineers. This paper proposes the Quantum Federated Digital Twin framework with eXplainable Multi-Agent Intelligence (QFDT-XMAI), a five-layer architecture that couples asset-level digital twins to a quantum-enhanced federated learning layer, a graph-attention multi-agent decision layer, and a dedicated explainability layer. The core methodological contribution is a quantum-fidelity-weighted aggregation rule (QFA-FW) that combines classical federated averaging with a quantum state-overlap weighting term computed from variational quantum circuits trained locally at each site, together with an explainable multi-agent proximal policy optimisation procedure (XMAPPO) that couples agent coordination with Shapley-based attribution and counterfactual validity scoring. The framework is evaluated on a simulated multi-site digital-twin testbed spanning predictive maintenance, dynamic scheduling, and energy-aware operation, and is benchmarked against classical federated averaging with single- and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning, and against quantum federated learning without multi-agent coordination. Simulation results indicate that QFDT-XMAI improves normalised policy return by 6 to 15 percentage points over the strongest baseline, reduces communication rounds required for convergence by approximately 22 percent, and raises the proposed Explainability Fidelity Index from 0.40–0.55 to 0.90 while maintaining comparable decision latency. The findings suggest that jointly engineering quantum-assisted federation, multi-agent coordination, and explainability, rather than treating them as separate add-ons, yields measurable gains for autonomous engineering management under data-locality and auditability constraints

full_list.title_en: AI extracts interpretable constitutive laws directly from solid-mechanics data
full_list.title_zh: 人工智能直接从固体力学数据中提取可解释的本构定律
full_list.abstract: Researchers at the Eastern Institute of Technology (EIT), Ningbo, have developed a graph-based approach that directly extracts concise, accurate constitutive equations from solid-material experimental data. The study, published in Science Advances, describes a method for discovering constitutive models for alloy steels, lithium metal and filled rubbers. It outperforms mainstream empirical models in predictive accuracy while preserving explicit, physically interpretable mathematical formulations.

full_list.title_en: LAMP: LLM-Augmented Multi-Task Spectral Prediction for Au-GaN Metasurfaces
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：LAMP: LLM-Augmented Multi-Task Spectral Prediction for Au-GaN Metasurfaces
full_list.abstract: Accurate multi-response spectral prediction is essential for metasurface performance evaluation, design-space exploration, and structural optimization. However, the underlying structure-to-spectrum mapping is highly nonlinear and requires the joint modeling of multiple optical responses over a broad wavelength range. Conventional neural predictors are effective at learning quantitative structure-to-spectrum relationships, whereas large language models (LLMs) can provide contextual representations of structural configurations. These two modeling paradigms, however, have largely been investigated independently. To bridge this gap, we propose LLM-augmented multi-task spectral prediction (LAMP), a dual-branch framework that integrates a spectral sequence encoder with a frozen LLM-based prompt encoder. An Align-then-Fuse (ATF) module is introduced to establish wavelength-aware interactions between the spectral and prompt representations through interactive alignment, followed by learnable residual fusion. The resulting representation is used for joint prediction of transmission amplitude, transmission phase, reflection amplitude, reflection phase, transmittance, and reflectance. Experiments on an Au-GaN metasurface dataset containing 56,576 structural configurations show that LAMP consistently reduces prediction errors across the six optical responses compared with conventional sequence-based predictors and direct LLM predictors. The framework also remains effective across different sequence backbones and language encoders. Ablation studies further verify the contributions of interactive alignment and residual fusion. These results demonstrate that LLM-derived contextual representations can provide complementary information for conventional neural predictors in multi-response metasurface spectral modeling.

full_list.title_en: Halide Perovskite Trilayer Metasurfaces for Ultrabright and Wide-Gamut Structural Color
full_list.title_zh: 用于超高亮度和宽色域结构色的卤化物钙钛矿三层超表面
full_list.abstract: We present an all-perovskite, gradient-index trilayer metasurface for reflective structural color based on a truncated-cone meta-atom comprising a black-phase α-CsPbI₃ core between two MAPbCl₃ cladding layers. The design translates the multilayer gradient-index concept previously demonstrated with GaP/TiO₂ into a chemically related halide-perovskite platform. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations show that, with the three-layer heights fixed at 90/100/80 nm, the palette can be generated primarily by scaling the lateral radii and lattice period. Seven representative colors are obtained with peak reflectance near unity in the reported simulations and resonance peaks spanning 470–630 nm. The calculated linewidth decreases from 63 nm for the shortest-wavelength design to approximately 19 nm for the red design. Near-field maps of the red structure are consistent with a magnetic-dipole-dominated Mie resonance localized predominantly within the high-index CsPbI₃ core. The circular in-plane symmetry gives polarization-insensitive behavior at normal incidence, while the angular maps indicate that the resonance remains identifiable to oblique incidence approaching approximately 40–50°. The corresponding CIE 1931 coordinates demonstrate a broad chromaticity range, with the violet, blue, and cyan designs extending beyond the sRGB gamut while the full set lies within the reported Adobe RGB and Rec. 2020 reference triangles. The results establish a simulation-level proof of concept for an all-perovskite structural-color architecture. Practical implementation will require careful control of the optical constants, phase stability of α-CsPbI₃, film quality, and nanofabrication compatibility.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种全钙钛矿梯度折射率三层超表面，用于反射式结构色，其截顶圆锥形超原子由夹在两层MAPbCl3包覆层之间的黑相α-CsPbI3核组成。时域有限差分模拟表明，在三层高度固定为90/100/80 nm时，主要通过调节横向半径和晶格周期即可生成多种颜色；代表性颜色的峰值反射率接近1，谐振峰覆盖470至630 nm。近场分布显示，红色结构主要由局域在高折射率CsPbI3核内的磁偶极主导的米氏谐振产生；实际实现仍需精确控制光学常数、α-CsPbI3的相稳定性、薄膜质量和纳米加工兼容性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种全钙钛矿梯度折射率三层超表面，用于反射式结构色。该超表面基于一种截顶圆锥形超原子，其结构为夹在两层MAPbCl3包覆层之间的黑相α-CsPbI3核。该设计将此前利用GaP/TiO2实现的多层梯度折射率概念转化到化学组成相关的卤化物钙钛矿平台上。时域有限差分（FDTD）模拟表明，在三层高度固定为90/100/80 nm时，主要通过缩放横向半径和晶格周期即可生成颜色调色板。研究报道了七种代表性颜色，其模拟峰值反射率接近1，谐振峰覆盖470至630 nm。计算得到的线宽从最短波长设计的63 nm降低到红色设计的约19 nm。红色结构的近场分布图与以磁偶极为主的米氏谐振相一致，该谐振主要局域在高折射率CsPbI3核内。面内圆对称性使结构在法向入射下具有与偏振无关的行为，而角度映射表明，直到接近约40至50度的斜入射角时，谐振仍然可以被识别。相应的CIE 1931坐标显示出宽广的色度范围，其中紫色、蓝色和青色设计超出了sRGB色域，而完整颜色集合均位于所报告的Adobe RGB和Rec. 2020参考三角形之内。这些结果建立了一个全钙钛矿结构色架构的模拟层面概念验证。实际实施仍需仔细控制光学常数、α-CsPbI3的相稳定性、薄膜质量以及纳米加工兼容性。
full_list.summary: 本文提出一种全钙钛矿梯度折射率三层超表面，用于反射式结构色，其截顶圆锥形超原子由夹在两层MAPbCl3包覆层之间的黑相α-CsPbI3核组成。时域有限差分模拟表明，在三层高度固定为90/100/80 nm时，主要通过调节横向半径和晶格周期即可生成多种颜色；代表性颜色的峰值反射率接近1，谐振峰覆盖470至630 nm。近场分布显示，红色结构主要由局域在高折射率CsPbI3核内的磁偶极主导的米氏谐振产生；实际实现仍需精确控制光学常数、α-CsPbI3的相稳定性、薄膜质量和纳米加工兼容性。
full_list.focus_summary: 该论文设计了由CsPbI3核心和MAPbCl3包层构成的卤化物钙钛矿三层超表面，并通过FDTD模拟获得高亮度、宽色域的结构色。研究表明，通过调节纳米结构横向尺寸和晶格周期，可以控制共振波长和反射颜色，并保持一定的偏振不敏感性。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、光学响应和光电材料方向存在联系，但主要采用电磁学FDTD模拟，涉及缺陷、载流子动力学和第一性原理电子结构的内容较少。可借鉴其钙钛矿异质纳米结构和光场调控设计。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合GW-BSE或时变密度泛函理论计算材料的真实介电函数和激发态性质。还可研究界面电荷转移、载流子复合、光致离子迁移以及热效应对超表面性能的影响。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：相稳定、相图与多相竞争，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于超高亮度和宽色域结构色的卤化物钙钛矿三层超表面》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Adsorption and photo-Fenton catalytic degradation of Orange II dye over cobalt ferrite nanoparticles and almond shell biochar
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Adsorption and photo-Fenton catalytic degradation of Orange II dye over cobalt ferrite nanoparticles and almond shell biochar
full_list.abstract: The purpose of this work is to synthesize and characterize new materials based on magnetic nanoparticles and almond shell biochar, and to evaluate their ability to remove Orange II dye from water sources. For this purpose, different systems were prepared: magnetic cobalt ferrite nanoparticles (MNP), MNP synthesized on almond shell biochar (BMNP) and a mechanical mixture of MNP and biochar (MM). These systems were characterized by X-ray diffraction, scanning electron microscopy, magnetic measurements and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, revealing different structural properties for the three samples. The adsorption kinetic was studied and the equilibrium time tested in this study was 50 minutes. The photo-Fenton catalytic degradation of Orange II was studied. For MNP system, tests were performed under different conditions: varying concentration of catalyst and peroxide, and pH. The concentration of peroxide of 600 ppm, the catalyst concentration of 75 mg/l and pH 3 were the conditions that allowed obtaining higher degradation percentages (> 90%). Under these optimal operation conditions, the dye removal capacity was evaluated for the three systems. BMNP system showed a higher degradation capacity (> 97%) in less time and more than 95% of the sorption capacity remained after 5 successive sorption-washing cycles, suggesting an excellent reusability. These cobalt ferrite nanoparticles synthesized on biochar are presented as an efficient and reusable catalyst to remove dyes like Orange II from wastewater from the textile and food industries using solar energy.

full_list.title_en: Competitive Displacement Fluorescence Biosensor Based on Aptamer-Peptide Conjugates for Simultaneous Detection of Pb 2+ and Cd 2+ in Rice
full_list.title_zh: 基于适配体-肽偶联物竞争置换荧光生物传感器同时检测大米中的Pb²⁺和Cd²⁺
full_list.abstract: Lead (Pb2+) and cadmium (Cd2+) frequently co-occur in agricultural products, making rapid methods for their sensitive and simultaneous detection highly necessary. Current fluorescence methods often rely on signal amplification, which increases assay time and complexity. To achieve rapid and amplification-free detection, we developed a fast and sensitive fluorescence biosensor by anchoring high affinity aptamer-peptide conjugates (APCs) onto tetrahedral DNA nanostructures (TDNs) functionalized Fe3O4/Au magnetic nanoparticles. In the presence of targets, Pb2+ and Cd2+ competitively displace the corresponding fluorescently labeled APCs from the magnetic nanoparticles into the supernatant. After magnetic separation, the released probes were quantified by measuring the fluorescence of the supernatant, enabling simultaneous determination of both metal ions within 30 min while minimizing matrix interference. This biosensor showed linear ranges of 0.3–10 nM for both ions, with detection limits of 0.103 nM Pb2+ and 0.081 nM Cd2+. When tested in rice samples, the sensor showed good accuracy, matching the validation results from standard ICP-MS. This work successfully integrates APCs into a TDN-modified magnetic DNA nanostructure interface to enable a simple displacement assay that can achieve reliable simultaneous determination of trace heavy metals in complex samples.
full_list.abstract_zh: 铅和镉常在农产品中共存，因此亟需快速、灵敏且可同时检测二者的方法。本文开发了一种无需信号扩增的快速荧光生物传感器：将高亲和力适配体-肽偶联物固定在四面体DNA纳米结构修饰的Fe3O4/Au磁性纳米颗粒上，目标离子通过竞争置换使荧光标记探针释放到上清液中。磁分离后，通过测量上清液荧光即可在30分钟内同时测定两种金属离子。该传感器对两种离子的线性范围均为0.3至10 nM，检测限分别为Pb²⁺ 0.103 nM和Cd²⁺ 0.081 nM，并在大米样品中获得了与标准ICP-MS验证结果一致的良好准确度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 铅（Pb²⁺）和镉（Cd²⁺）经常在农产品中共同出现，因此非常需要能够快速、灵敏且同时检测二者的方法。现有荧光方法通常依赖信号扩增，这会增加检测时间和复杂性。为实现快速且无需扩增的检测，我们开发了一种快速、灵敏的荧光生物传感器：将高亲和力适配体-肽偶联物（APC）固定在由四面体DNA纳米结构（TDN）功能化的Fe3O4/Au磁性纳米颗粒上。在目标物存在时，Pb²⁺和Cd²⁺会竞争性地将相应的荧光标记APC从磁性纳米颗粒上置换到上清液中。磁分离后，通过测量上清液的荧光对释放的探针进行定量，从而能够在30分钟内同时测定两种金属离子，并尽量降低基质干扰。该生物传感器对两种离子均表现出0.3至10 nM的线性范围，Pb²⁺和Cd²⁺的检测限分别为0.103 nM和0.081 nM。在大米样品中的测试表明，该传感器具有良好的准确度，与标准ICP-MS的验证结果一致。本研究成功地将APC整合到TDN修饰的磁性DNA纳米结构界面中，构建了一种简单的置换检测方法，可在复杂样品中可靠地同时测定痕量重金属。

full_list.title_en: Full-space multipolarization Janus reconfigurable intelligent metasurface with phase precompensation for bidirectional transmission and asymmetric reflection
full_list.title_zh: 具有相位预补偿功能的全空间多极化Janus可重构智能超表面：实现双向传输与非对称反射
full_list.abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) commonly control either reflection or transmission, limiting wavefront manipulation to one half-space or one propagation function. Here we present a full-space multipolarization Janus RIS that supports bidirectional reflection and orthogonally polarized bidirectional transmission within a single aperture. Each meta-atom couples a y-polarized receiving patch to an x-polarized transmitting patch through a microstrip delay line and incorporates two PIN diodes. The 00 and 11 diode states provide 1-bit phase control for forward y-polarized and backward x-polarized reflection, whereas the 01 and 10 states control bidirectional polarization-converting transmission. Delay-line phase precompensation supplies four reflection phases (0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°) and four transmission phases (0°, 45°, 90°, and 135°), mitigating the additional beam produced by 1-bit quantization under plane-wave illumination. Measurements of a 12 × 12 prototype demonstrate beam steering to ± 60°, peak gains of 18.31 dBi in reflection and 18.22 dBi in transmission, and measured aperture efficiencies of 21.3% and 20.7%, respectively. A sparse-aperture configuration further produces four simultaneous beams with orthogonal polarizations in the two half-spaces. The proposed architecture therefore consolidates bidirectional reflection, transmission, polarization conversion, and multibeam operation in one reconfigurable platform.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种全空间多极化Janus可重构智能超表面，可在单一孔径内实现双向反射以及正交极化的双向传输。每个超构单元通过微带延迟线将y极化接收贴片与x极化发射贴片耦合，并集成两个PIN二极管；不同二极管状态分别用于反射和偏振转换传输的相位控制。12×12原型样机实现了±60°波束扫描，反射和透射峰值增益分别为18.31 dBi和18.22 dBi，并可通过稀疏孔径产生两个半空间内具有正交极化的四个同时波束。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 可重构智能表面（RIS）通常只能控制反射或传输中的一种，这使波前操控局限于一个半空间或一种传播功能。在此，我们提出了一种全空间多极化Janus RIS，可在单一孔径内实现双向反射以及正交极化的双向传输。每个超构单元通过微带延迟线将y极化接收贴片与x极化发射贴片耦合，并集成两个PIN二极管。00和11二极管状态为前向y极化反射和后向x极化反射提供1比特相位控制，而01和10状态则控制双向偏振转换传输。延迟线相位预补偿提供了四种反射相位（0°、90°、180°和270°）以及四种传输相位（0°、45°、90°和135°），从而减弱了平面波照射下1比特量化产生的额外波束。对12×12原型样机的测量表明，该器件可实现±60°波束扫描，反射和透射峰值增益分别为18.31 dBi和18.22 dBi，测得孔径效率分别为21.3%和20.7%。此外，稀疏孔径配置还可在两个半空间内产生四个具有正交极化的同时波束。因此，所提出的架构在一个可重构平台中整合了双向反射、传输、偏振转换和多波束运行功能。

full_list.title_en: Automating Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) Formulation Generation from Natural Language
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Automating Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) Formulation Generation from Natural Language
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) is a central formulation for combinatorial optimization and has gained increasing attention due to its compatibility with quantum, hybrid quantum-classical, and quantum-inspired solvers. However, translating natural-language problem descriptions into correct QUBO formulations remains difficult, requiring the identification of binary variables, constraints, objective functions, penalty terms, and suitable penalty weights. This process is time-consuming and often demands substantial domain expertise. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end multi-agent framework that automatically generates QUBO formulations from natural-language problem descriptions, supported by structured or unstructured test cases. To evaluate its performance, We also introduce QUBOBench, a benchmark containing 100 combinatorial optimization problems across 12 application domains, curated from peer-reviewed literature, competitions, and canonical NP-hard problems. Experimental results show that our framework achieves 68% accuracy on QUBOBench, outperforming a direct single-call baseline by 22%. Further analysis identifies iterative self-repair as the most important component contributing to improved performance. The data and code are open-sourced at https://quitttcat.github.io/QuantumQUBOAgent.

full_list.title_en: Physicists turn classical light into a quantum machine for information processing
full_list.title_zh: 物理学家将经典光转化为用于信息处理的量子机器
full_list.abstract: Quantum computers promise to tackle problems that are extraordinarily difficult for today's computers. But there is a major obstacle: quantum systems are notoriously fragile. Noise, loss and even tiny disturbances can destroy the delicate behavior that gives them their power. Building systems with many quantum particles is also extremely challenging.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子计算机有望解决当今计算机难以处理的问题，但量子系统极其脆弱，噪声、损耗甚至微小扰动都可能破坏其脆弱的量子行为。与此同时，构建包含大量量子粒子的系统也极具挑战性。该报道介绍了一种将经典光转化为量子信息处理机器的研究方向。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算机有望解决当今计算机难以处理的极其复杂的问题。但这也面临一个重大障碍：量子系统出了名地脆弱。噪声、损耗，甚至微小的扰动，都可能破坏赋予量子系统强大能力的精细行为。构建包含大量量子粒子的系统同样极具挑战性。

full_list.title_zh: 用于室温监测可切换自旋交叉现象的丝网印刷少层石墨烯平台
full_list.abstract_zh: 该工作开发基于丝网印刷少层石墨烯的平台，用于在室温下监测可切换的自旋交叉现象。所提供信息仅包含题目及《Advanced Materials》的出版元数据，平台构型、检测方式与实际性能需查阅原文。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 所提供的原始摘要仅为《Advanced Materials》的出版信息，并未提供具体研究摘要。根据题目，该工作开发基于丝网印刷少层石墨烯的平台，用于在室温下监测可切换的自旋交叉现象，平台构型、检测方式与实际性能需查阅原文。
full_list.summary: 该工作开发基于丝网印刷少层石墨烯的平台，用于在室温下监测可切换的自旋交叉现象。所提供信息仅包含题目及《Advanced Materials》的出版元数据，平台构型、检测方式与实际性能需查阅原文。
full_list.journal: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于室温监测可切换自旋交叉现象的丝网印刷少层石墨烯平台》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT): a systematic procedure for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT): a systematic procedure for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems
full_list.abstract: We introduce the Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT), a systematic Lyapunov-spectrum-based procedure for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems. Rather than using Lyapunov exponents primarily to detect chaotic dynamics, the proposed approach exploits the structure of the complete Lyapunov spectrum over parameter space to identify signatures of additional first integrals and candidate integrable regimes. Conceptually inspired by the role of the Mandelbrot set in complex dynamics, the LIT systematically scans parameter space to reveal structures associated with complete and partial integrability. The applicability of the method is demonstrated on several benchmark systems, including the ABC flow, the heavy top, quantum dots, a helically symmetric Hamiltonian system with three degrees of freedom, and the classical double pendulum. In particular, the use of the complete Lyapunov spectrum enables the detection of partially integrable regimes that remain chaotic, demonstrating that the proposed approach provides information beyond the largest Lyapunov exponent alone. Across these examples, the LIT recovers known integrable and partially integrable parameter regimes and effectively guides the search for additional first integrals. It can therefore serve as a preliminary numerical screening tool for selecting promising parameter regions for subsequent analytical investigations of integrability.

full_list.title_en: Hydrochemical gradients and seasonal compartmentalization of legacy organochlorine pesticides in tropical estuarine water and sediments
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Hydrochemical gradients and seasonal compartmentalization of legacy organochlorine pesticides in tropical estuarine water and sediments
full_list.abstract: Organochlorine pesticides (OCPs) remain mobile in tropical estuaries through runoff, particle transport and sediment remobilization. Paired surface-water and surface-sediment samples were collected for one year at twelve stations in five river–estuary systems on the South Coast of Kenya. The study generated 144 paired station–month observations for each matrix. Fifteen identified OCPs and one unresolved chromatographic signal (HCN*) were retained for mixture analysis; HCN* was excluded from compound-specific interpretation and from the Σ15OCP. Mean concentrations ranged from 0.661 to 0.819 µg L− 1 in water and 1.614 to 1.731 µg kg− 1 dry weight in sediment. Centered-log-ratio principal component analysis showed multidimensional mixtures, with the first two axes explaining 33.8% of water and 29.0% of sediment variation. PERMANOVA detected seasonal and estuary-by-season structure in water profiles, whereas sediments showed estuarine and interaction effects. Crossed mixed-effects models estimated approximately 8.18-fold and 13.47-fold higher Σ15OCP burdens during the long rains than short rains in water and sediment, respectively. Dissolved oxygen was negatively associated with water burden. Partial redundancy analysis attributed 9.1% of residual water-mixture variation to hydrochemistry, with dissolved oxygen and pH contributing significant unique fractions. Paired total burdens were strongly correlated (Spearman ρ = 0.856), but complete mixture configurations were moderately concordant. The findings indicate that seasonal hydrological forcing regulates contaminant loading, whereas local estuarine conditions influence mixture composition, environmental partitioning and water–sediment coupling. There is need to integrate monitoring of water and sediment compartments for understanding the transport, retention and ecological exposure potential of legacy OCPs in tropical estuarine ecosystems.

full_list.title_en: Petrography and Palynology of Carbonate Concretions From the Lower Cretaceous Romualdo Formation Lagerstätte, Brazi
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Petrography and Palynology of Carbonate Concretions From the Lower Cretaceous Romualdo Formation Lagerstätte, Brazi
full_list.abstract: Carbonate concretions are among the most effective taphonomic capsules in the sedimentary record, isolating organic material from diagenetic alteration and enabling the preservation of three-dimensional skeletal structures, soft tissues, and associated microbial communities. The concretions of the Romualdo Formation (Aptian–Albian, Araripe Basin, Northeast Brazil) exemplify this preservational potential as part of one of the world's foremost Konservat-Lagerstätten, yielding vertebrate, invertebrate, and plant material. Despite the wealth of systematic research on these concretions, their diagenesis and internal palynological content remain poorly characterized relative to the broader palynological literature on the enclosing shales. Here we present integrated petrographic and palynological analyses of eight carbonate concretions nucleated around distinct organic substrates (fish remains, coprolites, and phytodetritus) collected from two shale horizons. Scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDS) and polarized-light petrographic microscopy, together with palynological slides analyzed under transmitted-light optical microscopy, revealed that concretion formation was syngenetic to early diagenetic, and proceeded through three stages: (i) fluorapatite nucleation on organic substrates at or near the sediment–water interface; (ii) carbonate precipitation during the first centimeters to meters of burial; and (iii) pyrite precipitation under progressively reducing conditions. Microfossils within the concretion matrix, including ostracodes (e.g., Pattersoncypris) and miliolid foraminifera, mirror those of the host shales, corroborating early cementation of ambient sediment. The palynological assemblage is dominated by Classopollis and Uesuguipollenites, with subordinate lycophyte spores, monilophyte spores, green algae (Botryococcus), and dinoflagellates (Batiacasphaera), collectively indicative of a warm, arid-to-semi-arid coastal–estuarine setting under strong marine influence during the late Early Cretaceous.

full_list.title_en: Safe-by-design algal EPS based ZnO/zeolite bio-nanocomposite for the removal of BPA
full_list.title_zh: 用于去除双酚A的安全设计型藻类胞外聚合物基氧化锌/沸石生物纳米复合材料
full_list.abstract: The existence of endocrine disrupting chemical (EDCs), like bisphenol-A (BPA) creates a huge challenge for conventional wastewater treatment plants. The current study has aimed to develop a hybrid adsorption-photocatalytic material for efficient BPA removal under UV-A irradiation. The characterization of the bio-nanocomposite was using FE-SEM, EDX, FTIR and total organic carbon (TOC). Batch experiments were performed to evaluate the effects of concentration, catalyst dosage, pH and an optimal bio-nanocomposite was developed. The optimized Zeolite:ZnO:EPS ratio of 1:1:0.5 achieved the highest BPA removal under UV-A irradiation. Reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging experiments identified superoxide radicals as the dominant oxidative species. In addition, degradation kinetics were determined to be pseudo-first-order. The TOC analysis further confirmed approximately 96% mineralization of BPA after UV-A irradiation. For the biosafety assessments, Scenedesmus obliquus and Allium sativum were used as model organisms. The results indicate that the presence of EPS reduced oxidative stress and have improved biological compatibility.
full_list.abstract_zh: 双酚A等内分泌干扰化学物给常规污水处理带来了重大挑战。本研究开发了一种在紫外-A光照下通过吸附-光催化协同作用高效去除双酚A的杂化材料，并考察了其组成、反应条件、降解动力学及生物安全性。优化后的沸石、氧化锌与胞外聚合物比例为1:1:0.5，双酚A矿化率约为96%，且胞外聚合物可降低氧化应激并改善生物相容性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 双酚A（BPA）等内分泌干扰化学物（EDCs）的存在给常规污水处理厂带来了巨大挑战。本研究旨在开发一种杂化吸附-光催化材料，用于在紫外-A（UV-A）照射下高效去除BPA。研究采用场发射扫描电子显微镜（FE-SEM）、能量色散X射线光谱（EDX）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和总有机碳（TOC）对该生物纳米复合材料进行表征。通过批量实验评估浓度、催化剂投加量和pH的影响，并制备出性能最优的生物纳米复合材料。在UV-A照射下，优化后的沸石、ZnO与EPS比例为1:1:0.5时，BPA去除率最高。活性氧（ROS）猝灭实验表明，超氧自由基是主要的氧化活性物种。此外，降解动力学被确定为拟一级动力学。TOC分析进一步证实，UV-A照射后BPA的矿化率约为96%。在生物安全性评估中，研究采用斜生栅藻（Scenedesmus obliquus）和大蒜（Allium sativum）作为模式生物。结果表明，EPS的存在降低了氧化应激，并改善了生物相容性。
full_list.summary: 双酚A等内分泌干扰化学物给常规污水处理带来了重大挑战。本研究开发了一种在紫外-A光照下通过吸附-光催化协同作用高效去除双酚A的杂化材料，并考察了其组成、反应条件、降解动力学及生物安全性。优化后的沸石、氧化锌与胞外聚合物比例为1:1:0.5，双酚A矿化率约为96%，且胞外聚合物可降低氧化应激并改善生物相容性。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 带电缺陷、缺陷形成能、陷阱态和器件退化在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Biochar-based carbon sequestration: physicochemical characterization and Assessment of carbon stability
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Biochar-based carbon sequestration: physicochemical characterization and Assessment of carbon stability
full_list.abstract: Biochar has attracted a lot of attention as a possible carbon-sequestration material because pyrolysis converts carbon produced from biomass into an extremely durable, carbon-rich solid. This work evaluated the carbon-stability characteristics of wood-derived biochar produced by slow pyrolysis at 700°C for 5 hours under oxygen-limited conditions using thorough physicochemical characterization. The structural, chemical, morphological, elemental, and surface properties were assessed using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), scanning electron microscopy combined with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM–EDX), and Brunauer–Emmett–Teller (BET) analysis. While FTIR revealed distinctive hydroxyl, aliphatic C–H, and oxygen-containing functional groups, the XRD pattern revealed a mostly disordered structure with crystalline and mineral-associated phases. A surface morphology with pores and interparticle spaces was found to be uneven and diverse by SEM. 85.91 weight percent C, 9.34 weight percent O, and 4.74 weight percent Ca were displayed by EDX. A heterogeneous porous structure with nitrogen adsorption reaching around 140 cm³ STP g⁻¹ was revealed by BET analysis. Overall, the findings show that the generated biochar has qualities that are advantageous for carbon stabilization and possible long-term carbon storage. However, to quantitatively confirm carbon persistence, field research and long-term incubation are needed.

full_list.title_en: 2AM: Grounding Agent-Side Memory as Guidance for Steerable Action Models in Long-Horizon Manipulation
full_list.title_zh: 2AM：将智能体侧记忆作为长时程操作中可操控动作模型的引导
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11308v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires memory, but not necessarily inside the action policy. To address such tasks, current agentic systems often combine VLAs with planners and geometric tools, sometimes using additional depth or calibrated geometry. These systems confound attribution: gains may come from richer observations or alternative motor tools, while failures may stem from either the policy or an under-specified language interface. We isolate this question through a deliberately constrained design: less tool breadth, but greater interface bandwidth. 2AM makes a multimodal Agent the sole holder of task memory and a single RGB-based, episodically stateless Action Model the sole executor of task-relevant motion. The Agent compiles interaction history into subtask language and optional 2D grasp, place, and move hints that bind its physical intention at different time scales. To teach this steerability to the VLA, we augment demonstrations with structured hint labels and train under condition dropout, spatial noise, and temporal jitter to tolerate imperfect Agent outputs. On LIBERO-Mem, without depth, online geometry, or planner-based object motion, 2AM reaches 76.3% average completion, a 61.5-point improvement over the strongest reported baseline of 14.8%, together with 63.0% relaxed and 11.8% strict success. These results show that task memory can remain Agent-side. They further show that Action Model capability depends not only on what the policy has learned, but on how precisely the Agent can steer it.
full_list.abstract_zh: 长时程机器人操作需要记忆，但记忆不一定要位于动作策略内部。2AM采用受约束的设计：多模态智能体独自持有任务记忆，而一个基于单目RGB、在每个情节中无状态的动作模型独自执行与任务相关的运动。智能体将交互历史编译为子任务语言，并可提供二维抓取、放置和移动提示；动作模型则通过结构化提示标签、条件丢弃、空间噪声和时间抖动训练来适应这些提示。在不使用深度、在线几何或基于规划器的物体运动的情况下，2AM在LIBERO-Mem上达到76.3%的平均完成率，较最强已报告基线提高61.5个百分点，说明任务记忆可以保留在智能体侧，而动作模型能力也取决于智能体引导的精确程度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 长时程机器人操作需要记忆，但记忆并不一定要位于动作策略内部。为处理这类任务，当前的智能体系统通常将视觉语言动作模型与规划器和几何工具结合起来，有时还使用额外的深度信息或标定几何。这些系统使性能提升难以归因：收益可能来自更丰富的观测或替代性的运动工具，而失败可能源自动作策略本身，也可能源于定义不充分的语言接口。我们通过一种有意受限的设计来隔离这一问题：减少工具范围，但提高接口带宽。2AM让一个多模态智能体成为任务记忆的唯一持有者，让一个仅基于RGB、在每个情节中无状态的动作模型成为与任务相关运动的唯一执行者。智能体将交互历史编译成子任务语言，并可提供可选的二维抓取、放置和移动提示，这些提示在不同时间尺度上约束其物理意图。为了教会视觉语言动作模型具备这种可操控性，我们使用结构化提示标签增强示范数据，并在条件丢弃、空间噪声和时间抖动下进行训练，使模型能够容忍智能体输出的不完美。在LIBERO-Mem上，在不使用深度、在线几何或基于规划器的物体运动的情况下，2AM达到76.3%的平均完成率，相比已报告的最强基线14.8%提高61.5个百分点，同时达到63.0%的宽松成功率和11.8%的严格成功率。这些结果表明，任务记忆可以保留在智能体侧。结果还表明，动作模型的能力不仅取决于策略学到了什么，也取决于智能体能够以多高的精度对其进行引导。

full_list.title_en: AI-Powered Flare Combustion Efficiency Estimation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AI-Powered Flare Combustion Efficiency Estimation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving high combustion efficiency in flare stacks is crucial for adhering to regulatory standards and controlling the release of hydrocarbons into the environment. Traditional instruments like gas analyzers and hyperspectral cameras are expensive, fragile, and require frequent calibration, which makes them impractical for remote or budget constrained industrial sites. We propose an innovative solution that combines a lightweight vision-language encoder with a compact multi-layer perceptron to predict combustion efficiency directly from low-cost thermal video footage. The fully trained model is integrated into an easy-to-deploy graphical user interface. This interface overlays predicted combustion efficiency values on each video frame, displays real-time trends in combustion efficiency, shows the distribution of combustion efficiency across all frames in the video, and allows users to export CSV reports. Over a six-month period, the system achieved 99% uptime and required less than 15 minutes of maintenance per week.

full_list.title_en: GPU-CFR: 80x Faster Counterfactual Regret Minimization by Compiling the Game to Static Dataflow and CUDA Graph Replay
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：GPU-CFR: 80x Faster Counterfactual Regret Minimization by Compiling the Game to Static Dataflow and CUDA Graph Replay
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11923v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) is one of the few large numerical workloads that still runs faster on CPUs than on GPUs. Each iteration sweeps a game tree with up to billions of states in millions of small, interdependent gather and scatter steps issued through a generic tree interface. On a GPU every kernel finishes in microseconds, so kernel launches and framework dispatch dominate the run time, and prior GPU implementations have lost to optimized CPU code. We observe that for a fixed game, everything about a CFR iteration except the numerical values is known before the first iteration runs. We propose GPU-CFR, a compiler and runtime built on this observation. It compiles any game once into static dataflow: flat edge and information-set arrays, precomputed indices, and depth-level batched passes fix the entire operation sequence, and only solver state changes between iterations. Static chance folding, depth-level execution blocks, and a dual-lane reach buffer cut the number of framework operations by up to 18.1x. Because shapes, indices, and buffer addresses never change, CUDA Graph Replay records the iteration once and replays it with a single graph launch. On one A100, across an eight-game suite that spans card games, dice games, and board games, GPU-CFR runs 29.8--80.4x faster than the fastest prior GPU CFR on the same accelerator, and 14--258x faster than LiteEFG, one of the fastest open-source CPU implementations, on the four largest games. The compiled representation carries most of that margin: on eight CPU threads with no accelerator it is already 2.2--51.1x faster than the GPU baseline. On the CPU the optimized path reproduces the reference iterates bitwise, and tree construction and graph capture pay for themselves within the first solve. GPU-CFR beats every CPU and GPU baseline on the mid-to-large games of the suite without changing the update rule.

full_list.title_en: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents
full_list.title_zh: 使智能体记忆扎根于环境：面向企业智能体的环境探测式记忆整理
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent memory is entering production-oriented agent platforms to help long-horizon agents accumulate experience across sessions. Yet a post-task curator agent restricted to completed trajectories can preserve errors, overgeneralize partial evidence, or retain stale knowledge. We introduce environment-probing curation, a deployment-compatible extension that gives an existing asynchronous curator agent least-privilege, read-only world tools to check, scope, and refresh candidate memories. It requires no model retraining and leaves the task agent, retriever, memory representation, and production write authority unchanged. In a production-like GitHub Copilot (GHCP) harness built on its SDK, we compare stateless execution, full in-context learning, GHCP + Mem, and GHCP + Mem (w/ Env Probing) on CLBench database exploration and 90 adapted APEX management-consulting tasks. On CLBench, probing raises pass rate from 39% to 73% and pass-discounted reward from 8.60 to 22.60 while reducing queries from 8.8 to 4.7 per question and task-agent cost from 3.38 to 1.68. Across six APEX worlds, all 18 memory-versus-baseline mean reward comparisons are positive and task-agent tool calls fall by 16--75%; probing gives the best task-agent reward gain per dollar in five worlds. Probing also attains higher mean reward than GHCP + Mem on both Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7 without schema drift. Environment probing therefore turns existing agent-memory curation into an environment-informed, auditable process while preserving a compact task-time interface.
full_list.abstract_zh: 持久化记忆正在进入面向生产环境的智能体平台，以帮助长时程智能体跨会话积累经验。然而，如果任务结束后的整理智能体只能访问已完成的轨迹，就可能保留错误、过度概括不完整证据或保存过时知识。本文提出环境探测式整理：在不重新训练模型的情况下，为现有异步整理智能体提供遵循最小权限原则的只读环境工具，以核验、限定范围并更新候选记忆。在基于GitHub Copilot SDK的生产式测试框架中，该方法在数据库探索和管理咨询任务上提高了成功率与奖励，同时减少了查询次数和任务智能体成本，并在多个环境中取得了更好的单位成本奖励增益。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 持久化记忆正在进入面向生产环境的智能体平台，以帮助长时程智能体跨会话积累经验。然而，仅受限于已完成轨迹的任务后整理智能体可能保留错误、过度概括不完整证据，或保留过时知识。我们提出环境探测式整理，这是一种与部署兼容的扩展：它为现有异步整理智能体提供遵循最小权限原则的只读世界工具，用于核验、限定范围并刷新候选记忆。该方法无需重新训练模型，并且不改变任务智能体、检索器、记忆表示或生产环境中的写入权限。在基于GitHub Copilot（GHCP）SDK构建的生产式测试框架中，我们在CLBench数据库探索任务和90个改编的APEX管理咨询任务上比较了无状态执行、完整上下文学习、GHCP + Mem以及GHCP + Mem（带环境探测）。在CLBench上，环境探测将通过率从39%提高到73%，将按通过率折算的奖励从8.60提高到22.60，同时将每个问题的查询次数从8.8次降至4.7次，并将任务智能体成本从3.38降至1.68。在六个APEX环境中，18个记忆方法相对于基线的平均奖励比较全部为正，任务智能体工具调用次数下降了16%至75%；在其中五个环境中，环境探测带来了单位成本最高的任务智能体奖励增益。在Sonnet 4.6和Opus 4.7上，与GHCP + Mem相比，环境探测均取得了更高的平均奖励，且没有出现模式漂移。因此，环境探测将现有的智能体记忆整理转变为一种以环境信息为依据、可审计的过程，同时保留紧凑的任务时接口。

full_list.title_en: Portable Semantics, Private Dialects: Reuse and Negative Transfer in Latent Communication Between Language-Model Cells
full_list.title_zh: 可迁移语义与私有方言：语言模型单元潜在通信中的复用与负迁移
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In shared-genome language-model societies, restricted evidence visibility favors reusable, value-indexed latent packet interfaces, whereas the sole high-performing globally visible model in the parent study learned an episode-entangled code. This companion study asks whether independently trained societies share one packet language, where strict zero-shot transfer fails, and whether inherited interface state helps or harms later learning. First, a leakage-controlled causal interoperability audit over all 30 ordered pairs of six independently trained restricted societies -- under sealed held-out structure and a preregistered raw/orthogonal/linear/nonlinear alignment ladder -- shows the six semantically similar interfaces do not form one raw language: one same-initialization pair is exactly interoperable in both directions, a second shows asymmetric partial compatibility, and all 26 cross-initialization directions fail every frozen alignment rung. Second, within the tested decomposition and a single sealed source formulation, a source-span control localizes strict zero-shot failure to interpretation and execution of the new operator instructions. Third, in a matched adaptation factorial, the globally trained communication interface acts as a severe negative-transfer prior: reinitializing only the packet reader, writer, and mouth raises final depth-three accuracy from 0.169 to 0.857. Fourth, across two restricted checkpoints and two independently frozen target streams each, inherited interfaces never exceeded fresh-interface controls by the preregistered 0.10 margin. All primary conclusions are bounded to a near-transfer 17-state setting; the negative-transfer factorial concerns one globally visible parent-cohort checkpoint, while an appendix adds a post hoc tagged-global twin case study.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在共享基因组的语言模型社会中，受限的证据可见性有利于形成可复用、按价值索引的潜在数据包接口，而全局可见性最高的模型却学会了与具体情节纠缠的编码。本文研究独立训练的社会是否共享同一种数据包语言、严格零样本迁移为何失败，以及继承的接口状态会促进还是阻碍后续学习。对六个独立训练的受限社会进行互操作性审计后发现，它们并不共享一种原始语言；在适配实验中，仅重新初始化数据包读写器和输出模块，就使最终三层深度准确率从0.169提高到0.857，表明继承接口可能造成严重负迁移。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在共享基因组的语言模型社会中，受限的证据可见性有利于形成可复用、按价值索引的潜在数据包接口，而先前研究中唯一具有高性能且全局可见的模型学会的是一种与具体情节纠缠的编码。本配套研究考察以下问题：独立训练的社会是否共享一种数据包语言；严格零样本迁移在何处失败；以及继承的接口状态是否有助于或妨碍后续学习。首先，在预注册的原始、正交、线性和非线性对齐阶梯下，我们对六个独立训练的受限社会的全部30个有序配对开展了控制信息泄漏的因果互操作性审计，并使用封闭的留出结构进行评估。结果表明，这六种语义相近的接口并不构成一种统一的原始语言：其中一个具有相同初始化的配对在两个方向上都完全互操作，另一个配对表现出非对称的部分兼容性，而所有26个跨初始化方向均未通过任何一级冻结对齐测试。其次，在所测试的分解方式和一个封闭的源端表述下，源跨度控制实验将严格零样本失败定位到对新算子指令的解释和执行环节。第三，在匹配的适配析因实验中，全局训练的通信接口成为一种严重的负迁移先验：仅重新初始化数据包读取器、写入器和输出模块，就使最终三层深度准确率从0.169提高到0.857。第四，在两个受限检查点和每个检查点对应的两个独立冻结目标流上，继承的接口从未以预注册的0.10幅度超过新接口对照组。所有主要结论均限于一个近迁移的17状态设置；负迁移析因实验涉及一个全局可见的父代群体检查点，附录则补充了一个事后标记的全局孪生案例研究。

full_list.title_en: The Agent Incident Registry: Toward Preventing Repeated AI Agent Failures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The Agent Incident Registry: Toward Preventing Repeated AI Agent Failures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents increasingly act through tools and delegated authority, but general incident repositories rarely capture the mechanisms needed to compare public failures with agent-security evaluations. We present the Agent Incident Registry (AIR), a source-linked catalog containing N{} records of agent-related events disclosed from Yfirst{} through Ylast{}. Each record includes supporting evidence, a stable identifier, and missingness-aware labels for causal role, disclosure class, mechanism, and outcome. Among the Nprimary{} generative-system records in which the agent acted, Rprimary{} involved realized harm (Pprimary%). Realized outcomes concentrate in in-the-wild and safety-failure records, while responsible disclosures and research demonstrations are overwhelmingly demonstrated; the aggregate share therefore characterizes collection composition rather than deployment risk. After initial curation, a second human reviewer checked all N{} records and their existing labels for completeness and correctness. In a deployment-analogue audit, InjecAgent's NInjecAgentCases{} cases occupy three of AIR's twelve surfaces and are all attacker-triggered, whereas AIR contains Nsafety{} no-adversary safety failures. AIR supports source-grounded case retrieval and evaluation-scope auditing, not failure-rate or control-efficacy estimation.

full_list.title_en: An integrated super-resolution THz imaging system based on a nonlocal freeform Bessel beam lens and high-power oscillator–radiator array
full_list.title_zh: 基于非局域自由曲面贝塞尔光束透镜与高功率振荡器-辐射器阵列的一体化超分辨率太赫兹成像系统
full_list.abstract: High-performance terahertz (THz) 3D imaging is critical for non-destructive evaluation. However, conventional architectures are fundamentally limited by severe chromatic aberrations, modest spatial resolution, restricted depths of focus (DOF), and the bulky nature of commercial transceivers. While metasurfaces offer a compact alternative, achieving broadband achromatic super-resolution with an extended DOF remains a formidable challenge. Here, we present a highly integrated 3D THz imaging platform that synergizes a 3D-printed nonlocal freeform Bessel-beam lens with a high-power, 65-nm CMOS oscillator-radiator array. Harnessing nonlocal interactions within the lens, we generate an achromatic super-resolution Bessel beam (0.3–1 THz) with a sub-diffraction full width at half maximum (FWHM) of 0.65λ and a robust 4.7-mm DOF. Crucially, the system overcomes conventional sidelobe limitations, enabling high-fidelity 2D imaging of intricate sub-millimeter targets (e.g., USAF 1951 charts and QR codes) alongside robust 3D volumetric imaging through highly scattering media, such as printed circuit boards. By converging standard CMOS technology with additive manufacturing, this work establishes a versatile, cost-effective paradigm for next-generation integrated THz photonics
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种高度集成的三维太赫兹成像平台，将三维打印的非局域自由曲面贝塞尔光束透镜与65纳米CMOS高功率振荡器-辐射器阵列相结合。该系统在0.3至1 THz范围内产生消色差超分辨率贝塞尔光束，实现0.65λ的亚衍射半高全宽和4.7毫米景深。系统可对复杂亚毫米目标进行高保真二维成像，并能穿过强散射介质实现稳健的三维体成像。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 高性能太赫兹（THz）三维成像对于无损检测至关重要。然而，传统架构从根本上受到严重色差、空间分辨率有限、景深（DOF）较小以及商用收发器体积庞大等因素的限制。尽管超表面提供了一种紧凑的替代方案，但要实现具有扩展景深的宽带消色差超分辨率仍然极具挑战。在此，我们提出了一种高度集成的三维THz成像平台，将三维打印的非局域自由曲面贝塞尔光束透镜与采用65纳米CMOS工艺的高功率振荡器-辐射器阵列相结合。利用透镜内部的非局域相互作用，我们在0.3至1 THz范围内产生了消色差超分辨率贝塞尔光束，其亚衍射半高全宽（FWHM）为0.65λ，并具有稳定的4.7毫米景深。更为重要的是，该系统克服了传统旁瓣的限制，能够对复杂的亚毫米目标（如USAF 1951分辨率板和二维码）进行高保真二维成像，同时还可穿过印刷电路板等强散射介质实现稳健的三维体成像。通过将标准CMOS技术与增材制造相结合，本工作为下一代集成太赫兹光子学建立了一种通用且具有成本效益的技术范式。

full_list.title_en: Discovery of a New Class of Optical Discharges in the Lower Atmosphere
full_list.title_zh: 低层大气中新型光学放电的发现
full_list.abstract: Thunderstorms produce energetic particles, radio emissions, and lightning, yet optical manifestations of electrical discharges in the lower atmosphere remain largely unexplored. Here we report the discovery of a class of blue–violet optical discharges observed beneath thunderclouds. Using synchronized all-sky cameras, three-camera stereoscopic imaging, near-surface electric-field measurements, energetic-particle detectors, radio-frequency measurements, lightning observations, and cloud-base estimates at the Aragats high-altitude research station, we obtained the first comprehensive multiparametric characterization of these optical phenomena. The observations demonstrate that these emissions comprise two fundamentally different discharge regimes controlled by the polarity of the near-surface electric field. Positive electric fields produce compact, elevated blue–violet blobs and elongated luminous structures, whereas negative electric fields generate diffuse corona and streamer-corona emissions associated with grounded structures. Three-camera stereoscopy places the best-validated compact sources at approximately 50–65 m above the station. We propose a physical model in which the two optical regimes originate from different lower-thunderstorm dipoles: the LPCR–Earth dipole produces free-air streamer development, whereas the MN–Earth dipole favors corona and streamer-corona discharges on grounded objects. These observations reveal a previously unknown component of thunderstorm electrodynamics, establish a new class of atmospheric optical discharges, and introduce a new observational window into streamer formation, energetic-particle acceleration, and lightning initiation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究利用多种同步观测手段，首次对雷暴云下方的蓝紫色光学放电进行了全面的多参数表征。结果表明，近地面电场极性控制着两种本质不同的放电模式：正电场产生悬空的致密光团和细长发光结构，负电场则产生与接地结构相关的弥散电晕及流光电晕。研究提出了基于不同低层雷暴偶极子的物理模型，为理解流光形成、高能粒子加速和闪电起始提供了新的观测窗口。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 雷暴会产生高能粒子、无线电辐射和闪电，但低层大气中放电的光学表现仍在很大程度上未得到探索。本文报告了一类在雷暴云下方观测到的蓝紫色光学放电。通过在阿拉加茨高海拔研究站使用同步全天空相机、三相机立体成像、近地面电场测量仪器、高能粒子探测器、射频测量设备、闪电观测设备以及云底高度估算方法，我们首次对这些光学现象进行了全面的多参数表征。观测结果表明，这些光学辐射包含两种本质不同的放电模式，并受近地面电场极性控制。正电场会产生致密的高空蓝紫色光团和细长的发光结构，而负电场则会产生与接地结构相关的弥散电晕和流光电晕辐射。三相机立体观测将验证程度最高的致密光源定位在研究站上方约50至65米处。我们提出了一个物理模型，其中两种光学放电模式分别源于不同的低层雷暴偶极子：低层正电荷区与地球构成的偶极子会产生自由空气中的流光发展，而主负电荷区与地球构成的偶极子则有利于在接地物体上形成电晕和流光电晕放电。这些观测揭示了雷暴电动力学中一个此前未知的组成部分，确立了一类新的大气光学放电，并为研究流光形成、高能粒子加速和闪电起始开辟了新的观测窗口。

full_list.title_en: Effect of an intumescent flame-retardant coating on the pyrolysis and combustion characteristics of UV-aged wood
full_list.title_zh: 膨胀型阻燃涂层对紫外老化木材热解与燃烧特性的影响
full_list.abstract: Whether intumescent flame-retardant coatings retain their effectiveness on ultraviolet (UV)-aged wood remains unclear because photoaging alters the surface structure of the substrate. This study elucidated the thermal degradation pathway and fire-protective mechanism of an intumescent coating applied to UV-aged pine using thermogravimetry, isoconversional kinetics, kinetic model fitting, cone calorimetry, and char morphology analysis. The coating initiated dehydration and charring at lower temperatures but markedly delayed the main decomposition stage. Compared with UV-aged uncoated wood, the T50% increased by 49.36–69.67 ℃, while the char residue increased from 5.43–6.99% to 14.34–17.37%. The average apparent activation energy increased by 29.98 and 27.00 kJ·mol− 1 according to the Kissinger–Akahira–Sunose and Flynn–Wall–Ozawa methods, respectively. More importantly, the dominant kinetic mechanism shifted from a reaction-order model to an Avrami–Erofeev nucleation-and-growth model, revealing a transition from rapid degradation to controlled char formation. At 45 kW·m− 2, the peak heat release rate, peak mass loss rate, and total smoke production decreased by 50.44%, 44.52%, and 72.60%, respectively. Notably, the coated UV-aged wood formed a denser and more continuous honeycomb-like char layer than the coated unaged wood and exhibited the lowest fire growth tendency. These findings demonstrate that the coating remains effective after UV aging by redirecting wood pyrolysis toward condensed-phase charring and constructing a stable heat- and mass-transfer barrier.
full_list.abstract_zh: 由于光老化会改变木材基材的表面结构，膨胀型阻燃涂层在紫外老化木材上能否保持阻燃效果仍不明确。本研究结合热重分析、等转化率动力学、动力学模型拟合、锥形量热和炭层形貌分析，揭示了该涂层在紫外老化松木上的热降解路径与防火机制。涂层促进了低温脱水和成炭，同时显著延缓主要分解阶段；在45 kW·m⁻²下，峰值热释放速率、峰值质量损失速率和总烟释放量分别降低50.44%、44.52%和72.60%，表明涂层仍能有效促进木材向凝聚相成炭转变并形成稳定的传热传质屏障。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 由于光老化会改变基材的表面结构，膨胀型阻燃涂层在紫外（UV）老化木材上能否保持其有效性仍不明确。本研究采用热重分析、等转化率动力学、动力学模型拟合、锥形量热和炭层形貌分析，阐明了膨胀型涂层应用于紫外老化松木后的热降解路径和防火保护机制。该涂层在较低温度下启动脱水和成炭，但显著延缓了主要分解阶段。与未涂层的紫外老化木材相比，50%转化温度（T50%）提高了49.36至69.67 ℃，而炭残余率则由5.43%至6.99%提高到14.34%至17.37%。根据Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose和Flynn-Wall-Ozawa方法，平均表观活化能分别提高了29.98和27.00 kJ·mol⁻¹。更重要的是，主导动力学机制由反应级数模型转变为Avrami-Erofeev成核与生长模型，揭示了木材由快速降解向受控成炭的转变。在45 kW·m⁻²热辐射强度下，峰值热释放速率、峰值质量损失速率和总烟释放量分别降低了50.44%、44.52%和72.60%。值得注意的是，涂层紫外老化木材形成的炭层比涂层未老化木材形成的炭层更加致密和连续，呈蜂窝状结构，并表现出最低的火灾增长倾向。这些发现表明，该涂层在紫外老化后仍然有效，能够将木材热解重新导向凝聚相成炭，并构建稳定的传热和传质屏障。

full_list.title_en: Evidence-coupled bistability converts dependency structure into a recovery geometry
full_list.title_zh: 证据耦合双稳态将依赖结构转化为恢复几何
full_list.abstract: Dependency structure is known to constrain the order in which an adaptive system regains its capacities, but not the rest: whether recovery is self-sustaining, is held without support, stalls, or collapses. Here we place an evidence-coupled bistable cascade on a finite forward acyclic dependency chain: each capacity carries an evidence-dependent threshold, evidence accrues only while every prerequisite is online, and accumulated evidence lowers that threshold. We prove that consolidated evidence accelerates every capacity super-linearly, that the recovered and failed configurations are two stable states, and that the surface on which the root switches regime is exactly invariant, its position independent of the evidence timescale. That invariance is not bought by a postulated selector: the update follows from a two-regime Bayesian model with ambiguity-suspended updating, exclusivity arising in the sharp limit. Directional coupling then fixes the outcome: above an explicit sufficient bound every trajectory off the surface converges to full recovery or full collapse, while sufficiently weak coupling admits a stable partial state at consolidated evidence. Dependency structure thus gates when evidence can accumulate, and that gating, coupled to bistability, yields a recovery geometry whose outcomes depend on coupling strength and initial condition. Catatonia is the first biological instantiation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究在有限前向无环依赖链上构建证据耦合双稳态级联系统，分析依赖结构如何影响自适应系统的恢复或崩溃。研究证明，巩固后的证据能够以超线性方式加速各项能力恢复，完全恢复与完全失败构成两个稳定状态，而根节点切换状态的临界曲面不受证据时间尺度影响。耦合强度与初始条件共同决定系统最终走向完全恢复、完全崩溃或稳定的部分恢复状态，并以紧张症作为首个生物学实例。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 已知依赖结构会约束自适应系统重新获得各项能力的顺序，但它并不能决定恢复过程的其余性质，即恢复是否能够自我维持、能否在没有支持的情况下保持、是否会停滞，或者是否会崩溃。本文在有限的前向无环依赖链上设置了一个证据耦合双稳态级联系统：每项能力都具有一个依赖证据的阈值；只有当所有先决条件均处于在线状态时，证据才会累积；而累积的证据会降低该阈值。我们证明，巩固后的证据会以超线性方式加速每项能力，恢复配置和失败配置是两个稳定状态，而根节点发生状态切换的曲面严格保持不变，其位置与证据演化的时间尺度无关。这种不变性并非通过假定一个选择器获得：更新规则源自一个具有歧义暂停更新机制的双状态贝叶斯模型，并且互斥性在锐化极限下产生。随后，方向性耦合决定了最终结果：当耦合强度高于一个明确的充分界限时，所有不位于该曲面上的轨迹都会收敛至完全恢复或完全崩溃；而当耦合足够弱时，在证据得到巩固的情况下，系统允许存在稳定的部分恢复状态。因此，依赖结构控制证据何时能够累积，而这种门控机制与双稳态相结合，形成了一种恢复几何，其结果取决于耦合强度和初始条件。紧张症是这一机制的首个生物学实例。

core_items.title_en: Physics-guided explainable machine learning and uncertainty quantification for predicting unconfined compressive strength of nano shale–quicklime stabilized kaolin clay
core_items.title_zh: 用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土无侧限抗压强度的物理引导可解释机器学习与不确定性量化
core_items.abstract: Data-driven prediction of stabilized-soil strength is often constrained by small experimental datasets, leakage between related specimens, and limited physical interpretability. This study develops an explainable, uncertainty-aware framework to predict the unconfined compressive strength (UCS) of nano shale–quicklime stabilized kaolin. A specimen-level database of 180 measurements from 36 mixture–curing conditions was analyzed using multiple linear regression (MLR), support vector regression (SVR), random forest (RF), XGBoost, CatBoost, and backpropagation artificial neural network (BP-ANN), with nonlinear models optimized by particle swarm optimization and evaluated through nested GroupKFold cross-validation. Mechanism-inspired features represented binder dosage, binder–curing interactions, nonlinear curing behavior, relative plasticity, and compaction state. Sequential feature ablation identified a compact CatBoost model with six physics-guided descriptors, achieving R2 = 0.841 ± 0.123 and RMSE = 151.11 ± 34.94 kPa. SHAP analysis, sensitivity assessment, and two-dimensional partial dependence mapping identified plasticity, curing duration, and binder–curing interactions as dominant controls and revealed nonlinear stabilizer effects and favorable binder combinations. Monte Carlo input perturbation and group-bootstrap resampling quantified input-driven and model-related uncertainty, with the highest 95% prediction-interval coverage reaching 0.894. The framework provides a physically interpretable, reliability-aware approach for preliminary stabilized-soil screening while retaining confirmatory laboratory testing.
core_items.abstract_zh: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度，并比较了多种回归与机器学习模型。研究通过物理机制启发的特征、嵌套分组交叉验证、SHAP分析及不确定性量化，确定塑性、养护龄期和胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素；最终得到的紧凑型CatBoost模型在可靠性意识下为稳定土初步筛选提供了具有物理解释的工具，但仍需实验室试验进行确认。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度（UCS）。研究分析了一个试样层面的数据库，其中包含来自36种混合物-养护条件的180次测量，并采用多元线性回归（MLR）、支持向量回归（SVR）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost、CatBoost和反向传播人工神经网络（BP-ANN）进行建模；其中，非线性模型通过粒子群优化进行优化，并通过嵌套式GroupKFold交叉验证进行评估。受机理启发构建的特征表示了胶结料掺量、胶结料-养护相互作用、非线性养护行为、相对塑性和压实状态。顺序特征消融识别出一个包含六个物理引导描述符的紧凑型CatBoost模型，其表现达到R2 = 0.841 ± 0.123，RMSE = 151.11 ± 34.94 kPa。SHAP分析、敏感性评估和二维部分依赖关系映射表明，塑性、养护时间以及胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素，并揭示了非线性稳定剂效应和有利的胶结料组合。研究通过蒙特卡罗输入扰动和分组自助法重采样，分别量化了由输入引起的不确定性和与模型相关的不确定性；其中，最高的95%预测区间覆盖率达到0.894。该框架在保留实验室确认试验必要性的同时，为稳定土初步筛选提供了一种具有物理可解释性并关注可靠性的途径。
core_items.summary: 稳定土强度的数据驱动预测通常受到实验数据集较小、相关试样之间存在数据泄漏以及物理可解释性有限等因素的制约。本研究建立了一个具有可解释性和不确定性感知能力的框架，用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土的无侧限抗压强度，并比较了多种回归与机器学习模型。研究通过物理机制启发的特征、嵌套分组交叉验证、SHAP分析及不确定性量化，确定塑性、养护龄期和胶结料-养护相互作用是主要控制因素；最终得到的紧凑型CatBoost模型在可靠性意识下为稳定土初步筛选提供了具有物理解释的工具，但仍需实验室试验进行确认。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于预测纳米页岩-生石灰稳定高岭土无侧限抗压强度的物理引导可解释机器学习与不确定性量化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
core_items.title_zh: MindTopo：基础模型能够在拓扑空间中进行推理吗？
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.11900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo contains 11,030 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types with controllable difficulty. We benchmark 14 MLLMs and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, including 3 video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning, and the best-performing model remains far below observed human performance. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach plausible endpoints, but audited rollouts do not reliably follow environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions. Our website is at https://mind-topo.github.io/
core_items.abstract_zh: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度和形状等度量性质，也依赖在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。本文提出MindTopo基准，基于认知科学和形式拓扑学，从连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结五种性质评估基础模型的拓扑直觉，并分别考察推理和规划两个认知层次。实验包含11030个实例和13类可控制难度的程序生成任务，结果显示所有多模态大语言模型的推理表现均优于规划表现，最佳模型仍远低于人类水平；图像和视频生成增强的智能体也无法可靠地遵循环境动力学或在状态转换中保持拓扑结构。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 空间推理不仅取决于距离、角度和形状等度量性质，还取决于在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。认知科学将这些关系视为空间理解的基础，但对基础模型的评估主要集中于度量关系或依赖观察视角的关系。我们提出MindTopo，这是一个评估拓扑直觉的基准，涵盖五种基于认知科学和形式拓扑学的性质：连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结。MindTopo在两个认知层次上评估每种性质。推理任务要求模型识别拓扑关系，或推断这些关系如何变化。规划任务则将基础模型实例化为闭环智能体，由其策略选择环境动作。MindTopo包含11030个实例，覆盖13类可程序生成且难度可控的任务。我们对14个多模态大语言模型进行基准测试，并研究了加入图像和视频生成能力的智能体配置，其中包括在规划设置中使用的3个视频生成模型。所有多模态大语言模型在推理任务上的表现都优于规划任务，表现最好的模型仍远低于观察到的人类表现。在Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct上，监督微调和强化学习对推理能力的提升大于对规划能力的提升。生成的观测结果保留了局部线索并到达看似合理的终点，但经过审计的运行轨迹无法可靠地遵循环境动力学，也无法在状态转换过程中保持拓扑结构。
core_items.summary: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度和形状等度量性质，也依赖在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。本文提出MindTopo基准，基于认知科学和形式拓扑学，从连续性、分离性、顺序、包围和纽结五种性质评估基础模型的拓扑直觉，并分别考察推理和规划两个认知层次。实验包含11030个实例和13类可控制难度的程序生成任务，结果显示所有多模态大语言模型的推理表现均优于规划表现，最佳模型仍远低于人类水平；图像和视频生成增强的智能体也无法可靠地遵循环境动力学或在状态转换中保持拓扑结构。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：强化学习和闭环控制。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《MindTopo：基础模型能够在拓扑空间中进行推理吗？》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Electrolytes for Lithium Batteries
core_items.title_zh: 用于锂电池电解质电子结构分析的密度矩阵框架
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2607.25597v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electrolyte reactivity in lithium batteries is shaped by molecular functional groups, Li⁺ solvation and salt-anion participation. Conventional quantum chemistry is too computationally expensive for systematic analysis of diverse electrolyte molecules and their local solvation environments. Here we present EMolStudio, a density-matrix-centered AI platform for electronic-structure prediction and analysis. Its workflow integrates molecular functionalization, explicit Li⁺ first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction, and electronic-structure parsing. Applied to 163,655 functionalized molecules and 22,500 first-shell clusters across four lithium salts, we find that 1) functionalization separates CO₂Me, CN, F/CF₃, and sulfonyl groups by distinct shifts in frontier levels, electrostatic potential, and Li⁺-donor contact; 2) anion identity reshapes frontier-orbital localization, with LiTDI anchoring the highest occupied orbital on the anion across the library. By carrying a unified density-matrix representation from molecular functionalization to salt-resolved solvation shells, EMolStudio provides a general platform for understanding and designing battery electrolytes.
core_items.abstract_zh: 锂电池中电解质的反应性受到分子官能团、Li⁺溶剂化以及盐阴离子参与的共同影响，而传统量子化学方法难以系统分析多样化电解质分子及其局部溶剂化环境。本文提出以密度矩阵为核心的人工智能平台EMolStudio，整合分子官能化、显式Li⁺第一溶剂化层组装、密度矩阵预测和电子结构解析。对163655个官能化分子和22500个第一溶剂化层团簇的研究显示，不同官能团会引起前线能级、静电势和Li⁺-供体接触的特征性变化，阴离子种类则会重塑前线轨道局域化。该平台通过统一的密度矩阵表示连接分子官能化与盐分辨溶剂化壳层，为理解和设计电池电解质提供了通用工具。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 锂电池中电解质的反应性受到分子官能团、Li⁺溶剂化和盐阴离子参与的共同影响。传统量子化学方法的计算成本过高，难以对多样化的电解质分子及其局部溶剂化环境进行系统分析。在此，我们提出EMolStudio，这是一个以密度矩阵为核心的电子结构预测与分析人工智能平台。其工作流程整合了分子官能化、显式Li⁺第一溶剂化层组装、密度矩阵预测和电子结构解析。我们将其应用于163655个官能化分子和四种锂盐对应的22500个第一溶剂化层团簇，并发现：第一，官能化会通过前线能级、静电势和Li⁺-供体接触的不同变化，将CO₂Me、CN、F/CF₃和磺酰基区分开来；第二，阴离子种类会重新塑造前线轨道的局域化，其中LiTDI使整个分子库中的最高占据轨道定位在阴离子上。EMolStudio通过将统一的密度矩阵表示从分子官能化贯穿到盐分辨的溶剂化壳层，为理解和设计电池电解质提供了一个通用平台。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《用于锂电池电解质电子结构分析的密度矩阵框架》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Atomistic Mechanisms Triggered by Joule Heating Effects in Metallic Cu‐Bi Nanowires for Spintronics
core_items.title_zh: 焦耳热效应触发的金属铜铋纳米线中原子尺度机制及其自旋电子学意义
core_items.abstract_zh: 该工作研究金属铜铋纳米线在焦耳热效应作用下发生的原子尺度机制，并关注其与自旋电子学的关联。所提供信息仅包含题目及《Advanced Materials》的出版元数据，具体热致结构变化、原子迁移过程及器件意义需查阅原文。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 所提供的原始摘要仅为《Advanced Materials》的出版信息，并未提供具体研究摘要。根据题目，该工作研究金属铜铋纳米线在焦耳热效应作用下发生的原子尺度机制，并关注其与自旋电子学的关联，具体热致结构变化、原子迁移过程及器件意义需查阅原文。
core_items.summary: 该工作研究金属铜铋纳米线在焦耳热效应作用下发生的原子尺度机制，并关注其与自旋电子学的关联。所提供信息仅包含题目及《Advanced Materials》的出版元数据，具体热致结构变化、原子迁移过程及器件意义需查阅原文。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《焦耳热效应触发的金属铜铋纳米线中原子尺度机制及其自旋电子学意义》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
